Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate a polished, precise educational diagram for the Greenbox handbook. Actual raster illustration. Minimal flat editorial design, warm cream background #fbfaf7, dark forest green #205c43 text and connector arrows, very pale sage panels, clean dark line-art file/key/person icons. Large, crisp, highly legible text. Compact informative labels, generous margins. No photographs, 3D, decorative plants, landscapes, brand slogans, extra prose, watermark, or decorative title unrelated to the requested labels. Render ONLY the specified text verbatim. All arrows must accurately follow the specified direction. This will be embedded in a small reading column, so prioritize large labels over decoration.

Square composition. Title: "Two ways back in". Two separate upper boxes labeled "Your passphrase" (key icon) and "Any 3 of 5 custodians" (exactly five person icons, three solid green and two outlined). Both boxes have arrows pointing DOWN and converging into one middle box labeled "Recovery keys" with smaller line "master.key + verify.pub". One arrow down from that middle box to a bottom box labeled "Open your backup" with a file icon. The two upper routes are alternatives; do not connect them to each other. No other text.
title: Two ways back in
alt: Your passphrase or any three of five custodians recover master.key and verify.pub, which open the same backup.

Landscape 3:2 composition. Title: "Two different files". Two stacked horizontal lanes with generous spacing. TOP lane small heading "SETUP · PUBLIC", left person icon labeled "Custodian", center file icon labeled "Public key card", right person icon labeled "Creator". Clear arrows run Custodian → Public key card → Creator. Under top lane only this short caption: "Create once. Reuse for future backups." BOTTOM lane small heading "RECOVERY · SECRET", left person icon labeled "Custodian", center file icon labeled "Released share", right person icon labeled "Recovering person". Clear arrows run Custodian → Released share → Recovering person. Under bottom lane caption: "Send privately. Any 3 shares recover the package." Keep filenames absent; exact simple labels only. The lower lane concerns a share for one specific package, not a reusable public card.
title: Public cards and secret shares
alt: During setup, a custodian sends a reusable public key card to the creator. During recovery, a custodian privately sends a released secret share to the recovering person. Any three distinct shares from the same three-of-five package can recover it.

prompt: Edit the previous Greenbox protocol diagram, preserving the cream and green editorial style. Replace wallet derivation with age-keygen -pq, a post-quantum key pair, heir.key stays private, and heir.recipient goes to creator. Show random file key, AES-256-GCM encryption, Shamir 3 of 5, and age encryption of each share. Recovery: load saved heir.key, open any 3 shares, rebuild file key, decrypt backup.
title: Age key recovery
alt: Each heir generates a post-quantum age key pair, keeps heir.key private, and sends heir.recipient to the creator. A random file key encrypts the backup and is split into five shares, each encrypted to one heir. Any three heirs use their saved keys to release shares, reconstruct the file key, and decrypt the backup.
